name: RentRollAnalyzer
tagline: Rent roll, WALT and lease expiry analysis for commercial property portfolios
description: Interactive tenancy schedule for Power Apps and Power Pages: occupancy, WALT by rent or area (to expiry or break), clickable lease expiry profile, arrears and holdover alerts, reversion to market rent, grouped subtotals, review flags and notes, CSV export and a phone-first card view.
features: Portfolio KPIs: occupancy, WALT/WALE, passing rent, arrears, vacancy, reversion
Clickable lease expiry profile as % of passing rent
Holdover, notice, break and expiring-lease logic
Group by property, building, floor, use or expiry year with subtotals
Unit detail with lease term bar, rent review and options
Review flags and notes saved to one text column
CSV export, 15 outputs and a DOM event
Phone card list with drill-in detail; keyboard and screen-reader support
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
